# Buttons, containers, lists, menus and trees get their overview

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

> **Amended on 16 Nov 2026, after the cover producer reached `dev` (#20679, PR #21161).** Three things changed after this leaf was written, none of them a contributor's doing. A record without a cover renders no card (#21119). The examples are sorted into 22 groups in place of the Components family (#21141). Which examples stay, are renewed or retire is decided per entry on #21142. **This leaf delivers the records and their captions.** A maintainer applies the group ids and the record schema of today's `dev` when the pull request is integrated. Covers are not part of it and are no contributor's task.

The 13.5 gate asks that a stranger finds each component family's examples as an overview in which every example names what it proves (`ROADMAP.md`). `/examples/grid` is the pattern: 21 captioned Grid and Table demonstrations (#20500). The steward's map on #20498 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6757406109)) lists the families. This leaf covers the building blocks of an application's structure.

## The Problem

`examples/` holds 28 demonstrations of buttons, containers, layouts, lists, menus, panels, tabs, toolbars and trees. Two have a catalog record (`tab-container`, `dialog-drag-drop`), none has a caption, and 26 can be reached only by typing their URL. A stranger cannot see that the engine ships these batteries.

## The Architectural Reality

- One record per example in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`; the record's shape is documented on `apps/portal/model/Example.mjs`. The records of the Grid and Table group are the reference for the length and tone of a caption.
- A unit spec fails on a record without `feature` or `lookFor`. A record whose `image` is `null` renders no card, so a record can merge before its cover exists and appears when the cover lands.
- Inventory at `62f75736ba`, each path under `examples/` with its own `neo-config.json`: `button/base`, `button/effect`, `button/split` · `container/accordion`, `container/base`, `container/fragment` · `dialog` (record `dialog-drag-drop`) · `layout/card`, `layout/cube` · `list/animate`, `list/base`, `list/buffered`, `list/chip`, `list/circle`, `list/color` · `menu/context`, `menu/list`, `menu/panel`, `menu/tree` · `panel` · `popover` · `tab/container` (record `tab-container`) · `tabs` · `toolbar/breadcrumb`, `toolbar/paging` · `tree` · `treeAccordion` · `viewport`.
- **The home group of each path**, from the table on #21141: `button/*`, `menu/*`, `toolbar/*` → `buttons` · `container/*`, `layout/*`, `panel`, `viewport` → `layouts` · `list/*` → `lists` · `tree`, `treeAccordion` → `tree` · `tab/*`, `tabs` → `tabs` · `dialog`, `popover` → `dialogs`. PR #21162 turns the groups into data.
- The record's `component` field names the component a card shows ("List", "Menu", "Tree"); the cards of one component stand together in catalog order.
- neomjs.com answers by user agent: a request without a browser user agent gets 404 on a dist example path that a browser opens.
- Design authority: n/a — adds catalog records, calls no existing behavior wrong.

## The Fix

For every demonstration of the inventory: run it (`npm run server-start`, then its `index.html`), read its view and controller, and decide. It gets a record when one sentence can say what it proves; otherwise it stays out and the pull request says why. A record carries a stable string `id`, `name`, its group, `component`, `feature` (what it proves), `lookFor` (one action and what to observe), `scope` where it has a limit, its URLs and source, and `image: null`. The new records stand as one block directly after the record `dialog-drag-drop`, grouped by component, so that parallel pull requests touch different lines.

**The two records that exist (`tab-container`, `dialog-drag-drop`) keep their position and their cover.** The three dist URLs of `dialog-drag-drop` get an explicit `index.html`: their directory form lands on the Portal's home page.

**For the open pull request #20824:** its 24 records and captions are the contribution, and they stay the author's. A maintainer brings the branch onto today's `dev`: the group ids of the table above, the URL fields as `dev` has them now, and the spec's counts. The author is asked for nothing further unless a caption turns out wrong in the running example.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every path of the inventory is a record with its home group, or is named in the pull request with its reason for staying out.
- [ ] Each `feature` and `lookFor` was checked in the running example; the pull request names the build and the browser. A caption states no number the example does not show and names no commercial feature.
- [ ] Every URL of a record opens that example's own document in a browser on neomjs.com, in each of the four builds it names, or the build is omitted on the record.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples` passes with the new record counts. The count of visible cards does not change, since no new record has a cover.

## Out of Scope

- **Covers and their capture recipes.** They are #21146's, shot with the producer of #20679 once #21142 has ruled on the entry. An example on the configuration viewport gets its cover after the workbench (#21143), since that changes its frame.
- The verdict on an example (keep, renew, retire): #21142. A record for an example that later retires is removed there.
- The group definitions: #21141.
- The visual components, canvas, charts and wrappers (#20695); new examples; an engine fix for an example that turns out broken: file it and leave the example out.

## Avoided Traps

- A caption taken from a directory name: the grid map on #20498 checked configured views, controllers and stores, and several names promised more than the example shows.
- A scaffold-level example recorded for completeness (`viewport`, `container/base`): it enters only if a visitor learns something from running it.
- Moving the two existing records: the showcase order is delivered intent (#19640).
- **Asking a first-time contributor to follow a brief that moved under them.** The records were written to the brief of 10 Nov; what changed since is integrated by a maintainer.
- **A URL check without a browser user agent.** curl's default gets 404 where a browser gets the page; a status code alone also passes a redirect to the Portal's home page. Check the document's title.
